data.long_meaning: The name Hallette is derived from the Latin word 'halare' which means 'to heal' or 'to make whole'. The feminine form 'Hallette' can be translated as 'graceful one'. In Christian tradition, the name is believed to represent the spiritual grace and healing power of God.
